item.title: Lowe's cuts approximately 600 jobs in order to focus on frontline staff
item.description: Lowe’s says the affected employees will receive financial assistance, continued benefits for a period of time and career transition resources.

item.title: Rising costs, tough weather leave North Carolina soybean farmers facing hardest years yet
item.description: Farmers in North Carolina are facing tough economic conditions due to rising input costs, unpredictable weather, and increased global competition, leaving them struggling to stay profitable.

item.title: CMPD Chief Patterson pushing for higher pay, take home car for officers
item.description: Charlotte-Mecklenburg FOP President Daniel Redford and Police Chief Estella Patterson are pushing for better pay, benefits, and incentives to recruit and retain officers, as the department needs nearly 300 officers to fill vacancies.
